summary: Conditional multi-field getter. Copies three consecutive dword fields of the `this` object at offsets 0x64, 0x68 and 0x6C into the caller-provided output pointers a2, a3 and a4 respectively, each write guarded by its output pointer being non-null. Returns a4 (the third output pointer) regardless of whether any write occurred.

operations.description: Guard on output pointer a2 being non-null before the first write.
Copy the field at offset 0x64 (this[25]) into *a2.
Guard on output pointer a3 being non-null before the second write.
Copy the field at offset 0x68 (this[26]) into *a3.
Initialize the return value to a4.
Guard on output pointer a4 being non-null before the third write.
Copy the field at offset 0x6C (this[27]) into *a4.
